_about: The skeleton the client compares two tasks on (Templated Task Examples, Project Mark task review, read 2026-11-11): the decision form, the deciding lessons, how the solver detects each, the resolving moves, the file roles and the answer pattern. A reviewer swaps the nouns of one task into the other and counts the elements that carry across unchanged; a change of domain does not reset the count. Every key below is domain-free. `mechanisms` on a skeleton are free slugs in the build's own physics (compared exactly, so a near copy that keeps the mechanism is told from a templated build that re-points it). skeleton.py validates a skeleton against this file.

decision_forms.rank_n_name_one: rank a shortlist on one quantity and name the one
decision_forms.pick_one_of_few_options: choose one of two to five options (spans, versions, drafts, configurations), often against a limit
decision_forms.top_k_with_screen_runner_up: the k largest whose interval clears a screen, plus the next in line
decision_forms.ranked_list_under_cap: the top k by a quantity under a cap on places
decision_forms.set_over_threshold: every unit whose quantity clears a filed line: a designation, flagged or committed set
decision_forms.allocation_under_budget: fund lines or measures by value per cost until a budget is spent
decision_forms.act_if_interval_clears_line: act only if the whole interval sits on one side of a line
decision_forms.certify_figure_against_line: certify one figure for a stated population against a trigger line
decision_forms.go_hold_stop_on_figure: go, hold or stop on a point figure against a bar or break-even
decision_forms.banded_call_on_figure: a figure placed in one of several filed bands (renew in full, by half, stop)
decision_forms.count_to_standard: how many units (blocks, vehicles, accounts, places) a standard needs
decision_forms.dial_or_cap_setting: set a limit, ceiling, cap, threshold or pass mark
decision_forms.forecast_figure_with_range: a figure for a window not yet closed, with its range
decision_forms.ranked_causes_bridge: a change bridged to its causes and ranked
decision_forms.per_unit_diagnosis: many units each diagnosed: which went wrong, when, why and how much
decision_forms.monitoring_rule_with_alerts: a rule and its alert count over a stated history
decision_forms.reconciled_record_or_table: a conformed table or record with its control totals

answer_patterns.naive_leader_drops_winner_climbs: the naive leader falls and the true winner climbs from far down the ranking
answer_patterns.k_of_n_pass_budget_slack: k of n pass a per-unit test and the budget does not bind
answer_patterns.point_says_act_interval_says_no: the point estimate clears the line, the honest interval does not
answer_patterns.figure_crosses_bar: the naive figure and the golden sit on opposite sides of a bar
answer_patterns.each_correction_alone_flips: any one of several corrections on its own moves the figure across the bar
answer_patterns.no_single_correction_clears: no single correction is enough; only the corrections together cross the line
answer_patterns.shortcuts_land_on_distinct_wrong_answers: different shortcuts land on different wrong answers (the depth scale's level 5 mark)
answer_patterns.naive_set_swaps_members: the easy route keeps most of the set and swaps a few members
answer_patterns.count_off_by_a_few: the naive count is off by a few units
answer_patterns.pooled_figure_flips_call: the pooled figure lands the call on the wrong side or band
answer_patterns.bigger_unit_misses_out_runner_up: a unit with a bigger raw effect misses out and a runner-up is named
answer_patterns.naive_choice_wrong_window: the obvious choice of window or block (where the problem looks largest) is the wrong one
answer_patterns.robust_call_figures_graded: the call holds across every route; the graded figures carry the difficulty
answer_patterns.naive_set_overfunds: the easy route funds, flags or commits many more units than the golden

lessons.uncertainty_at_shared_unit: the interval is built at the unit that moves together (cluster, school, chain, winter), not on records treated as independent
lessons.planned_design_noise: a test is sized or read with the noise of the planned design, not the raw spread of the outcome
lessons.design_weights: records carry inverse inclusion probabilities from a sampling design (a two-phase follow-up, head-based sampling, strata) that no column states as a weight
lessons.shrinkage_small_samples: small or unequal samples are pooled toward their group (variance components, credibility, empirical Bayes) before ranking or cutting
lessons.variance_beyond_sampling_noise: units vary by more than sampling error allows (a cohort-to-cohort or period term), and leaving that term out misplaces the cut
lessons.selection_on_noisy_means: units picked for being best on noisy estimates regress when re-measured (winner's curse)
lessons.measurement_error_attenuation: a slope or ranking on a noisy measure understates the relation by the measure's reliability
lessons.errors_in_covariate: a declared or proxy covariate carries error that biases the fit; its error variance is measured and corrected
lessons.support_effect: the decision unit's variance differs from the sample's support (block against point), so the distribution is rescaled
lessons.serial_or_common_shock_dependence: units or periods share shocks, so an independent-unit binomial or Poisson badly understates the tail
lessons.interference_spillover: treated units take outcome from, or pass it to, untreated units in their own group, so those are no clean comparison
lessons.concurrent_change_in_comparison: another change reaches the comparison (or the treated) in the same window, so the comparison is refit on unaffected units or periods
lessons.non_parallel_pre_trend: the comparison was already diverging before the treatment, so a scaled comparison fails and a cohort follow-up or trend-adjusted design is needed
lessons.selection_on_peak_baseline: units were picked on an extreme period, so their own before-period overstates the counterfactual (regression to the mean)
lessons.survivor_selected_sample: the units in hand were selected by having survived or kept paying, so their own records cannot show how often such units stop
lessons.target_subset_selected_by_score: the units the decision reaches are a subset selected by a risk or priority score, so population rates do not apply to them
lessons.confounded_history_of_use: an option was used in the past exactly when it was most needed, so its record measures those days, not the option
lessons.self_selection_into_treatment: early adopters or volunteers differ from the units the decision will reach
lessons.pilot_unrepresentative_selection: the units a pilot ran were chosen on something that predicts the outcome, so the pilot's fit misses what the chooser selected on
lessons.transport_effect_modifiers: an effect measured on one population is carried to another whose units sit elsewhere on the properties the effect varies with
lessons.heterogeneity_carried_to_decision: the effect or trend differs by subgroup and the target's mix differs, so the decision is made on the split carried through every later step, not the pooled figure
lessons.composition_versus_behaviour: a metric moves because the mix of units shifts, not because the units changed
lessons.displacement_netting: part of an effect moves to neighbouring units and is netted because the decision counts the whole
lessons.downstream_offset: an action's gain or loss at one unit is partly undone at the units it affects (a wake recovered downwind, a neighbour's response), so the system's net differs from the unit's own
lessons.treatment_changes_who_is_observed: the treatment changes who has an outcome recorded, so a comparison among the observed is selected
lessons.instrument_noncompliance: assignment and receipt differ, so the effect is the assignment's scaled by compliance
lessons.effect_fade_with_time: an effect fades with time since its own start, so a later window gets the faded effect
lessons.cannibalisation_with_pretrend: what a launch takes from existing lines is measured with a design that handles the buyers' pre-launch trend
lessons.analog_event_calibration: a forecast quantity is calibrated on a set of past comparable events, with the form chosen by out-of-sample error across them
lessons.measurement_basis_break: how a quantity is recorded changed, so later values are rebuilt on the earlier basis from signals that did not change
lessons.detection_rate_changes_outcome: the recorded outcome depends on a detection or clearance rate that changed, so recorded counts are deflated by it
lessons.optional_record_unlogged_changes: changes are recorded only when someone chooses to (a top-up, a voluntary report), mostly the large ones, so the unrecorded part is estimated from a second source
lessons.record_as_of_its_date: a record holds only what was known on the day it was made, so it is compared with the other source to that day and grossed up for the rest
lessons.record_check_reporter_error: a self-report is validated against an administrative register on the periods both cover, each reporter's error carried to the period only the self-report covers
lessons.observation_window_coverage: the file no longer or not yet covers part of the estimand's window (a retention cut, an extract date), so the missing part is carried in at the level its own drivers give
lessons.frame_population_mismatch: the frame misses units the estimand covers (accounts joined after the frame, unregistered units), so they are reconciled and imputed
lessons.impute_by_resembling_units: missing units are imputed from the units that resemble them on the property that matters (the youngest employers), not from the frame's size classes
lessons.reporting_lag_nowcast: late reports are still arriving at the extract, so the period is completed from what earlier periods showed at the same point
lessons.completion_of_young_cohorts: cohorts not yet old enough are completed past their last observed day from later-age rates of the cohorts that resemble them
lessons.competing_risks: an exit of another kind ends exposure, so it is a competing event, not censoring
lessons.vintage_or_cohort_drift: newer cohorts run at different rates at the same age, so a pooled curve whose late ages come from old cohorts reads wrong
lessons.look_back_equalisation: an event's definition (first, new, repeat) depends on how far back the record reaches, equalised across the groups compared
lessons.censored_or_capped_observation: the outcome is recorded only up to a cap or limit (stock, instruction, timeout), so the censored part is modelled, not dropped
lessons.unit_identity_across_systems: the unit is rebuilt across a migration, re-keying or several channels before anything is counted, and the linkage decides counts
lessons.inherited_attribute_from_other_unit: a record's attribute (inclusion, cost, cause) is set by another unit it belongs to, not by itself
lessons.fixed_nuisance_component: the naive figure mixes in a fixed component (a test rig's give, a share failing on operation), separated by a fixed-plus-covariate fit across all tests
lessons.extrapolation_beyond_observed_range: the decision condition sits outside the range the record covers (colder, larger, faster), so the form is chosen at the record's own edge and carried
lessons.behavioural_response_measured: a behavioural response is measured from unit-level traces and its own shape used (a step, a threshold), not assumed smooth
lessons.marginal_not_average: the decision buys the marginal unit (the case an extra hour serves, the minutes that cross a threshold), not the average one
lessons.queue_or_capacity_replay: outcomes are replayed event by event through a capacity or queue model under each option
lessons.rebound_after_window: what an intervention removes or adds inside its window comes back or is borrowed from after it (a demand-response come-back, purchases pulled forward by a rebate or offer), so the effect is measured through the payback window and the later shortfall netted
lessons.normal_period_correction: a figure from an unusual period is corrected to a normal period with a long record
lessons.renewal_resets_hazard: a replaced item restarts its hazard, so the old item's rate is not carried past its likely failure
lessons.route_pre_emption: an outcome reached through two routes, one of which pre-empted the other and is now closed
lessons.device_setting_replay: a device acting only above or below a setting is replayed reading by reading on the recorded values
lessons.scaling_diminishing_returns: returns to a resource diminish past a pool or regime, so one curve through every point is wrong
lessons.degradation_form: an asset's capacity loss follows an early-life form different from a straight line
lessons.seasonal_shift_calibration: a rate from one season is carried to another by a factor calibrated on a record from the target season
lessons.simulation_with_fitted_inputs: a service level comes from a simulation whose inputs are each fitted (bursts, tails, clustered failures, rework)
lessons.latent_structure_estimation: a quantity never stated (a dealing distribution, a board) is estimated from its observed consequences
lessons.dated_cause_by_own_metric: an event's cause is dated by which unit's own metric degraded first against its own norm, not by who was named first
lessons.propagation_source_vs_victim: a fault propagates to the units that depend on it, so the source is the earliest onset, not the largest deviation
lessons.layered_receiving_body: a receiving body is layered, so a receptor draws only the sources entering at its layer
lessons.cancellation_of_offsetting_effects: two features move a quantity in opposite directions, so units with both show no shift and only units with one reveal it
lessons.leader_follower_spillover: units follow a leader's moves with a lag, an unlabelled link found in the data, so a unit's value includes its followers'
lessons.customer_specific_response: units respond to their own conditions in opposite directions, so a shared coefficient averages the signal away
lessons.endogenous_supply_instrument: supply was cut where demand was already weakening, so the response is identified from an outside instrument and builds over time
lessons.unknown_generating_process: the published formula assumes a generating process the data contradict, so the process is fitted from the data with a selection-aware check
lessons.asymmetric_response: rises and falls pass through with different timing or size, so one symmetric response misstates the counterfactual
lessons.forward_window_structure_change: a filed change in the forward window adds or removes a mechanism the history carries, so the closed period's ranking or rate does not carry forward
lessons.non_additive_aggregation: a quantity defined on a joint condition across parts (parties together, a shared peak) does not add across sites or parts
lessons.response_at_crossing_point: a move earns its response only where it crosses a reference level (a rival's price, a threshold), measured on the units that crossed
lessons.capacity_held_for_planned_use: a resource recorded full was partly held empty for planned work, which only the relation between each allocation and its occupant shows
lessons.stock_flow_accounting: a draw is inflow less what accumulated inside the system, so reading inflow as draw misses the peak exactly when the reserve is drawn down
lessons.asynchronous_measurement_covariance: components struck at different times take a shock in different intervals, so same-interval covariances miss part of it
lessons.exposure_seen_only_in_linked_record: the outcome's driver is recorded only by another body, so only linking the two records unit by unit shows a period when it surged
lessons.length_biased_sampling: items or people enter the record with probability proportional to their duration or their frequency (snapshots of work in progress, intercepts by visit, votes by repeat voters, notices by repeat notifiers), so each record is weighted by one over its multiplicity
lessons.dependent_capture_channels: two capture channels are not independent (the second follows up what the first caught), so the two-source estimate inflates the overlap
lessons.validation_cannot_see_condition: every past case a back-test runs on carried a condition the forward cases lack, so the back-test passes by construction
lessons.unmetered_component: part of what the decision unit will draw or lose was supplied or lost through a source no meter records, so the recorded figure misses it
lessons.left_truncated_ages: units enter the record mid-life (a migration resets their recorded start), so ages and hazards read from first sight are wrong
lessons.device_clock_drift: each device keeps its own drifting clock and short memory, so its events are matched to an independent record on its own clock
lessons.linkage_missing_not_at_random: a link key is captured less often exactly when the outcome surges, so linked counts are reweighted by the capture share at their own conditions
lessons.common_error_benchmark: the benchmark an estimate is checked against shares one of its errors (the same unrecorded leavers on both), so their agreement validates nothing and the benchmark's own gap is sized from a third source
lessons.calendar_grid_shift: a profile keyed to a calendar grid's numbering (week or period number) drifts against the date-anchored events that drive it, and a long year moves the grid a whole step, so the profile is rebuilt on the events' dates
lessons.exposure_basis_decoupled: an event rate is carried on an exposure that moved in step with its true driver in the record (flight hours with landings), so every in-sample check passes on the conventional basis, and the forward plan decouples the two
lessons.staggered_conversion_at_renewal: a fix is embodied unit by unit at each unit's next shop visit, so the population converts at the pace of its own removals and the forward rate is neither the pooled rate nor the fixed one
lessons.scheduled_completion_slippage: a plan's dated works are carried into the forward window at the completion the organisation's own record of comparable past works supports, not at the planned date, so a benefit the plan books for the window is only partly there
lessons.intervention_masks_outcome: the units flagged as risky were rescued, treated, expedited or audited, so their recorded outcome is the intervention's, not the underlying risk; what would have happened is rebuilt from units the intervention could not reach
lessons.chance_coincidence_baseline: events linked only by time and place include chance matches and background exposure, so a placebo baseline from shifted days or windows is subtracted
lessons.open_follow_up_censoring: units have not had the full follow-up window yet, so unfinished cases are censored and completed by survival curves (by cohort where cohorts differ), never counted as non-events
lessons.immortal_time_exposure: an exposure or registration only units that survived long enough could receive credits the waiting time to the exposed, so each clock starts at entry or at a landmark among those still active
lessons.repeated_exposure_response: a trial measured isolated exposures but the decision is a run of consecutive ones (fatigue, carryover, saturation), so the effect is split by prior exposure and carried through the target schedule
lessons.depleting_stock_of_easy_cases: a trial's yield came from a one-off stock of easy cases that has run out, so the forward rate is projected from the replenishment flow
lessons.assignment_odds_by_group: randomisation or serving odds differed by tier, grade or segment, so the arms are compared within each assignment group and weighted to the target
lessons.closure_diversion: a closing unit's demand is split among the remaining units by a diversion share measured on past closures or sold-out periods, not in proportion to their size
lessons.fixed_count_effect_rescaled: a past intervention removed or added a fixed number of things, so its effect is rescaled to each unit's own base before it is applied
lessons.survey_design_change: a survey redesign, rotating panel or recall change moved the headline, so the two designs are bridged (first interviews, entering panel group, contact-schedule step) before the change is read
lessons.fieldwork_season_mix: groups were surveyed or exposed in different seasons, so the month profile is estimated within fixed units and everyone is adjusted to an average month
lessons.recorded_at_billing_location: activity is recorded where a supplier or lab bills, not where people live, so the national supplier is stripped out of the local figures
lessons.hindsight_in_evaluation: a rule or controller is judged with information it could not have had at the time, so it is replayed on what was known at each decision date (never the deciding step on its own)
lessons.conservation_residual_attribution: the quantity wanted is the residual of an account the physics or the books must close (an energy, mass or cash balance), so every metered, deemed and unmetered term is rebuilt on one basis and window before the residual is read and attributed
lessons.time_varying_membership: units' membership in a parent (a feeder, territory, portfolio or hierarchy) changed over the history, so each period's members are rebuilt from the dated operations record, not from today's register, and checked against the flows the changes moved
lessons.nonlinear_functional_of_path: the outcome is a convex or threshold function of a load or exposure path (losses with the square of current, ageing exponential in temperature, a charge on the maximum), so it is computed on the path, never on its mean or as a percentage carried from another level
lessons.position_on_network_effect: the same load or fault has a different effect by where it sits on a radial or graph structure (voltage drop and losses grow with distance, delay with hops), so an equivalent factor calibrated on an old spatial mix misstates a new one
lessons.record_algorithm_inversion: the stored record is the output of a recording algorithm (exception reporting, estimation and editing, a rolling register, a billing cycle), so the algorithm is inverted before anything is measured; never decided by reading one field
lessons.coincidental_agreement_joint_frequencies: distinct units agree on every identifying field by chance far more often than the product of the fields' own frequencies implies, because the fields are dependent and concentrated where the rule runs (first names by birth cohort and community, surnames by community, dates heaped on conventions), so a match rule's false-merge rate is read from the joint distribution of the population it runs on, never from independent per-field rates
lessons.lot_size_cycle_stock: a stock is held because supply arrives in lots the process sizes (a brew, a production run, a trunk load), so it scales with the lot and the number of items rather than with throughput
lessons.response_before_the_trigger: an announced change is answered between its announcement and the date it bites (cancellations at the bill after the notice), so a response read only at the effective date misses it and the window is read from the announcement
lessons.intensive_margin_response: a price change moves how much the staying units use, not only whether they stay, so under a cost priced per unit of use the stayers' consumption response is measured, not assumed unchanged

detections.naive_depends_on_what_it_should_not: the naive figure moves with something it should be free of
detections.naive_ignores_what_it_should_depend_on: the naive figure is flat where the mechanism says it should move
detections.units_move_together: units sit on the same side together far more often than independence allows
detections.untreated_neighbours_shift_with_exposure: untreated units shift with the share of their group gone live
detections.second_source_at_other_grain: a second record at another grain disagrees with the first
detections.control_total_gap: the reconciled record falls short of an independent control total
detections.record_time_against_event_time: the relation between when a record was made and when the events it covers happened
detections.onset_order_against_own_norm: which unit left its own load-matched norm first
detections.unchanged_signal_diverges: a signal that did not change diverges from the one that did
detections.split_half_replication: the measure barely replicates across split halves
detections.pre_period_divergence: the groups already diverged before the treatment
detections.selection_rule_in_the_record: the record of how units were picked (a start log, a selection note, a schedule's criterion)
detections.residual_by_subgroup: residuals sort by a subgroup or age the model left out
detections.layout_or_physics: the physical layout or mechanism implies an interaction the per-unit view misses
detections.natural_experiment_in_record: the record holds episodes (outages, pauses, a test) that show the effect directly
detections.back_test_on_held_out_period: a chronological back-test separates the readings
detections.document_defines_estimand: the governing document defines the quantity in a way the incumbent figure does not meet
detections.conservation_residual_sign: a balance's residual takes a sign or size the physics or the books do not allow, somewhere in the history
detections.flow_step_at_dated_operation: a parent's flow steps at the time of a dated operation that moved members between parents, mirrored at the receiving parent
detections.measurement_at_another_network_point: a measurement taken at another point of the network (an end-of-line voltage, a downstream meter) that the hurried model must also reproduce
detections.conflict_marker_in_linked_pairs: an attribute the match never used (a blood group, a birth, a sex-specific event) conflicts inside linked pairs at the rate random distinct pairs would conflict, which counts the distinct pairs the rule joined

moves.fixed_plus_covariate_fit: a fixed component plus a covariate term fitted across all tests, then re-ranked
moves.cluster_resample_shared_unit: intervals or resamples at the shared unit
moves.exposure_share_regression_unit_time_effe: staggered exposure shares regressed with unit and time effects
moves.inverse_inclusion_weights: each record weighted by its inverse inclusion probability
moves.two_phase_weights: follow-up completes weighted to stand for all first-phase nonrespondents
moves.impute_by_model_at_own_drivers: a missing part carried in at the level its own drivers give
moves.transport_by_effect_modifiers: the effect estimated by modifier cell and carried to the target's mix
moves.stratify_by_mix_and_reweight_to_target: each subgroup carried separately and recombined at the target's mix
moves.competing_risks_estimator: an Aalen-Johansen or cause-specific estimator with the other exit as competing
moves.complete_cohorts_from_later_rates: young cohorts completed from later-age rates of the cohorts that resemble them
moves.per_cohort_curves: one curve per cohort or vintage, recombined by exposure
moves.shrinkage_or_credibility_weighting: estimates pooled toward their group by a credibility or variance-component weight
moves.variance_components: between and within variance split, a cohort term added
moves.changepoint_on_own_metric: each unit's own metric against its own norm, the first departure dated
moves.align_to_record_date_and_gross_up: each record compared to its own date and grossed up by the share seen by then in earlier years
moves.link_records_by_parsed_key: records linked across systems by a parsed or normalised key
moves.replay_event_by_event: each period replayed event by event through the mechanism under each option
moves.simulate_with_fitted_inputs: a simulation fed by separately fitted inputs, back-tested
moves.long_record_normalisation: a long reference record scales the period to a normal one
moves.refit_comparison_on_unaffected: the comparison refit only on units or periods the treatment could not reach
moves.exclude_contaminated_comparison: units that share a link with the treated left out of the comparison
moves.pre_peak_baseline: the baseline taken from periods before the selection year
moves.net_displacement: the effect moved next door estimated the same way and netted
moves.measure_response_shape_from_events: a unit-level event definition, then the response's shape measured on it
moves.deflate_by_detection_rate: recorded counts divided by the measured detection or clearance rate
moves.rebuild_on_unchanged_signals: the quantity modelled on signals the break did not touch, fitted before it and applied after
moves.nowcast_from_same_point_prior_years: the period completed from what earlier periods showed at the same point
moves.paired_differences_of_planned_design: the planned design laid on history and its own paired differences used
moves.back_test_select_estimator: rival estimators compared on a held-out period and the best kept
moves.errors_in_variables_correction: the covariate's error variance measured and the fit corrected
moves.censored_survival_model: a censored hazard or survival fit on time since the clock's own start
moves.censored_regression: censored observations entered at their limit in the likelihood
moves.capped_ceiling_model: a min of the call and an available ceiling fitted
moves.cohort_follow_up: a fixed cohort followed in both groups so entries and turnover drop out
moves.comparison_group_same_selection: a comparison group built from the wider record by the same selection criterion as the units in hand
moves.excess_hazard_on_base_table: a measured excess rate added on top of a base table that rises with age
moves.analog_calibration_loo: a forecast form calibrated across past comparable events, chosen by leave-one-out error
moves.trend_adjusted_comparison: a comparison that removes the units' own pre-period trend
moves.equalise_look_back: each group given the same depth of earlier record
moves.frame_reconciliation_with_register: the frame reconciled with an administrative register to find missing and out-of-scope units
moves.survival_model_with_score: the target's selection score entered in a survival or response model
moves.calibrate_season_on_target_list: a seasonal factor calibrated on a record from the target season
moves.age_to_send_date: each unit aged to the date the decision acts
moves.reference_unit_unaffected: an unaffected reference unit chosen from the layout
moves.variant_sweep_holds_call: a sweep of defensible variants run and the call shown to hold
moves.lee_bounds_or_trimming: bounds that rest on random assignment alone
moves.instrument_outside_shock: an outside shock used as an instrument, the response built over its lag
moves.em_latent_fit: a latent distribution fitted by EM, checked on rounds no stopping choice selected
moves.lagged_pair_detection: leader and follower pairs found from lagged, demeaned changes
moves.per_unit_model_then_rank: a model for each unit, then the units ranked
moves.bridge_by_contribution: each component's contribution computed so the pieces add to the total
moves.degradation_curve_fit: an early-life degradation form fitted and carried to the decision date
moves.extrapolate_form_chosen_at_edge: the functional form chosen on the record's own edge and carried past it
moves.instrument_on_assignment: assignment used as the instrument for receipt
moves.ratio_benchmark_adjustment: a raising factor set so the estimate's ratio between two groups matches an independent benchmark built at another grain (births by sex rolled forward with survival)
moves.rekey_profile_to_event_dates: a seasonal profile rebuilt on the dates of the events that drive it (a holiday, a cut-off), then summed onto the target calendar's grid
moves.rate_on_driver_exposure: each event rate fitted on every exposure that could drive it (hours, landings, calendar time) across units whose exposures diverge, then carried on the forward plan's own exposures
moves.empirical_completion_from_past_works: each planned in-service date carried at the slip distribution of the organisation's comparable completed works, and the forward value weighted by the chance each is in service in time
moves.rebuild_membership_from_operations_log: each period's members rebuilt by replaying the dated operations (switching, transfers, re-parenting) on the structure, checked against the steps they cause in the parents' flows
moves.weighted_balance_reconciliation: every term of the balance rebuilt on one basis and window, the residual reconciled with each instrument weighted by its own accuracy, and its sign and size checked against physics
moves.compute_on_joint_path: the non-additive or nonlinear quantity computed interval by interval on the joint path, never from the parts' own summaries
moves.allocate_by_network_position: each load placed at its position on the network and its effect computed segment by segment (a backward sweep), validated on a measurement taken at another point of the network
moves.invert_recording_algorithm: the recording rule (deadband, estimation, cycle, rolling window) applied in reverse to recover the quantity at the decision's grain

closed_lessons._about: The client's Overused stumping strategies page (guidelines/client/learning-modules/overused-strategies-2026-11-12.md): 34 lessons that already decide the answer in two or more accepted tasks, all closed. A lesson keyed here may be a supporting step of a new task, never the step that flips its answer; a chain whose lessons are all closed is a stack of repeats; same mechanism and the same kind of fix is the same lesson whatever the domain, data or detection. skeleton.py findings() blocks a card whose deciding lesson (lessons[0]) is closed, or whose chain is closed or taught for more than half its lessons, and counts every closed lesson as taught.
